parameters.query: INSERT INTO alerts (alert_type, category, severity, title, description, ip_address, status) SELECT $1, 'security', $2, $3, $4, $5, 'new' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alerts WHERE ip_address = $5 AND category = 'security' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes') RETURNING id;
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM alerts WHERE ip_address = $1 AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour';
